description: This file contains the implementation of the VoiceWakeManager class, which manages speech recognition for voice commands in an Android application. It handles starting/stopping listening, processing speech results, and dispatching recognized commands via a coroutine callback.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Manages voice recognition, listening for trigger words, handling speech recognition lifecycle, and executing commands in an Android environment.

methods.name: setTriggerWords
methods.description: Sets the list of trigger words that activate command recognition.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the speech recognition process, setting up the recognizer and starting listening.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the speech recognition, cancelling current recognition and updating state.

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Configures and starts the speech recognizer listening for speech input.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of listening after a delay, used to recover from errors or end of speech.

methods.name: handleTranscription
methods.description: Processes recognized speech text, extracting commands, and invoking callback if appropriate.
